independent_computation.quantity: resource_spent = sum over ability casts inside the fight window of that ability's mana cost at its rank (Syndra's resource is MANA; data/champions.json Syndra.resource = 'MANA').

R Unleashed Power.passive: Dark Sphere's cooldown is reduced equivalent to 10/20/30 ability haste

sourced_inputs.P Transcendent: Splinters of Wrath stack up to 120; Q's Transcendent Bonus unlocks at 40 Splinters.

independent_computation.step_1_scenario_reading: The scenario suffix '120' is the Splinter-of-Wrath stack count, the passive's maximum ('stacking up to 120 times' / 'At 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra achieves Transcendence'). At 120 stacks every Transcendent Bonus threshold (40 Q, 60 W, 80 E, 100 R) is active. The independently cached audit note agrees: data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json, Syndra — 'E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage)'.
independent_computation.step_2_charge_model: Dark Sphere is a recharge (ammo/charge) ability — data/champions.json Syndra.Q.rechargeRate = [7,7,7,7,7], and the wiki-atom 'stack-transform-summon-resource.ammo' lists "stocked ability casts (… Syndra's Dark Sphere)". Its Transcendent Bonus at >=40 Splinters: 'Collecting 40 Splinters of Wrath causes Syndra to periodically stock a Dark Sphere charge, up to a maximum of 2.' With max charges C and recharge r, a fight that starts at full charges yields casts at t = 0 (x C, spaced by cast time) then one per recharge: N_casts(T) = C + floor(T/r). Against the one-charge baseline N = 1 + floor(T/r), raising C from 1 to 2 adds exactly ONE Dark Sphere cast for any window, and charges never change the per-cast mana cost. Extra mana = one Q cost.
independent_computation.step_3_uniqueness_scan: Brute force over every reachable rank vector (Q,W,E in 1..5, R in 1..3, level<=20 with R gated at 6/11/16), every base ability haste 0..200 in steps of 5 (Q additionally receiving R's 10/20/30 haste), and every window T in 0.25..40 s in 0.25 s steps, using the shared-timeline renewal counting of docs/math-foundations.md (cast counted when it starts inside the window; R exactly once per timed fight). The ONLY configurations in which the one-charge Q model totals 530 and the two-charge Q model totals 590 at the same (ranks, haste, window) are Q rank 5 / W rank 5 with cast counts Q=3->4, W=2, E=1, R=1.

step_4_arithmetic.old_530: 3 x Q(rank5, 60) + 2 x W(rank5, 100) + 1 x E(50) + 1 x R(100) = 180 + 200 + 50 + 100 = 530  [one-charge Dark Sphere, i.e. Transcendent Q bonus NOT applied]
step_4_arithmetic.new_590: 4 x Q(rank5, 60) + 2 x W(rank5, 100) + 1 x E(50) + 1 x R(100) = 240 + 200 + 50 + 100 = 590  [two-charge Dark Sphere, Transcendent Q bonus applied at >=40 Splinters]

step_5_feasibility_checks: Mana pool is not the binding constraint: Syndra mana = 480 + 40 x (L-1) x (0.7025 + 0.0175 x (L-1)); at L18 = 480 + 40 x 17 = 1160 (and at L16, the earliest R3, = 1059). 590 spent is affordable, so no truncation by resource pool; the passive additionally restores 20:255 mana per Splinter collected from an enemy.

The delta cannot be explained by any other single ability: 60 is Q's rank-5 cost; matching 60 with W would require W rank 1, which is incompatible with 530's forced W rank 5 in the same scenario, and E (50 flat) and R (100 flat) cannot produce a 60 delta.
independent_computation.conclusion: 530 is the mana bill of a Syndra who never gets her stocked second Dark Sphere. The scenario pins her at 120 Splinters, well past the 40-Splinter threshold, so the second charge is live and its cast is paid for. 590 is the correct resource_spent.

caveats: The scenario's exact window length, item haste and level were not readable from the permitted evidence tree; they were inverted from the two reported totals. The inversion is unique: over the full grid of reachable ranks, haste 0-200 and windows 0.25-40 s, the only (ranks, haste, window) family reproducing 530 under a one-charge Dark Sphere and 590 under the two-charge Dark Sphere is Q5/W5 with counts Q=3->4, W=2, E=1, R=1.
Ruling is on resource_spent only; no claim is made about the other leaves of this scenario.
verdict_reason: The scenario sits at the passive's maximum 120 Splinters of Wrath, past the 40-Splinter threshold that stocks a second Dark Sphere charge. A two-charge recharge ability fires exactly one more cast per window than a one-charge one, and each Dark Sphere cast bills its full rank-5 cost of 60 mana. 530 omits that cast; 590 includes it.
